'''2007 Illinois State Championship Nate Taylor DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nate Taylor]] at [[2007 Illinois State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Dark Side
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
